title: Evaluation of patients with total coronary occlusions with multimodality image.
official: Evaluation of patients with total coronary occlusions with multimodality image.
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the concordance between coronary CT angiography with myocardial perfusion imaging at stress and rest and stress cardiac MRI for the detection of ischemia and viability in patients with chronic total occlusion (CTO).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Chronic total occlusion in a native coronary artery
2. Age 18 years or older
3. Distal vessel to the chronic occlusion with a diameter of at least 2.5 mm
4. Ability to provide informed consent and willingness to comply with the follow-up protocol
Exclusion criteria:
1. Multivessel disease with incomplete revascularization in the artery without chronic total occlusions.
2. Severe valvular disease requiring surgery.
3. Allergy to iodinated contrast.
4. Previous revascularization surgery in the artery with chronic total occlusion.
5. Acute myocardial infarction within the past 3 months.
6. Coronary anatomy not favorable for percutaneous revascularization of the chronic total occlusion.
7. Coronary artery disease involving the left main or three vessels requiring surgery as assessed by the multidisciplinary team.
8. Life expectancy less than 2 years.
9. Severe chronic renal insufficiency (glomerular filtration rate ≤ 30 mL/min).
10. Contraindication to dual antiplatelet therapy.
11. Pregnancy.
